{{family name hatnote|Navarro|Brugal|lang=Spanish}}
'''David Navarro Brugal''' (born 17 May 1983) is a Spanish former professional [[basketball]] player. He played for several [[Liga ACB]] clubs including [[Obradoiro CAB|Monbus Obradoiro]] and [[BC Andorra|MoraBanc Andorra]].

==Professional career==
After spending his first years as a professional mainly in [[Catalonia]], Navarro made his debut in [[Liga ACB]] in 2005 with [[Bàsquet Manresa]].

He came back to [[LEB Oro]] for playing with [[CB Sant Josep|Sant Josep Girona]], before coming back to the top tier with [[Valencia Basket]] in February 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.solobasket.com/competiciones-feb/david-navarro-el-trotamundos-de-esparreguera|publisher=Solobasket|date=27 November 2013|language=es|accessdate=30 May 2017|title=David Navarro, el 'trotamundos' de Esparreguera}}</ref>

In 2013, Navarro agreed terms with [[BC Andorra|River Andorra]], where he became captain of the club after several years in the team of the Principality. In his first season, Andorra conquered the title of the [[2012–13 LEB Oro season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.marca.com/2014/03/22/baloncesto/basketfeb/1395527831.html|publisher=Marca|date=22 March 2014|accessdate=30 May 2017|language=es|title=El River Andorra sella el ascenso a la ACB}}</ref>

On June 28, 2017, Navarro signed a two-year contract with [[Obradoiro CAB]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Obradoiro tabs David Navarro|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/238831/obradoiro-tabs-david-navarro.html|accessdate=28 June 2017|work=Sportando.com|date=28 June 2017}}</ref>

==International career==
After living four years in [[Andorra]], Navarro was declared able to play with the [[Andorra national basketball team|Andorra national team]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://zonadebasquet.com/2017/05/29/juegos-de-los-pequenos-estados-de-europa/|date=29 May 2017|accessdate=30 May 2017|language=es|publisher=Zona de Básquet|title=Juegos de los Pequeños Estados de Europa}}</ref> as a result of a special eligibility rule from FIBA Europe for small countries.

He made his debut in May 2017, at the [[Basketball at the 2017 Games of the Small States of Europe|2017 Games of the Small States of Europe]] in [[San Marino]].<ref>{{cite web|language=ca|url=http://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/58228/rss|title=Una cerimònia que destaca el valor d'anar tots plegats|publisher=El Periòdic d'Andorra|date=30 May 2017|accessdate=30 May 2017}}</ref>
